Apple reports Q4
9to5Mac reports: Apple reports Q4. Apple made $114.5 billion in the three months to September, more than analysts had expected.
The Verge reports: iPhone record. iPhone sales were $57.6 billion.

Duo supply is short
The Verge reports: Duo supply is short. Two suppliers have stopped taking orders until March.
9to5Mac reports: Apple stock drops. Shares fell 3% in early trading after the report on the folding phone's screens, then recovered by noon.
Six Colors reports: The iPhone Duo, explained. It folds.
